title: Arrivée à l'aéroport Roland Garros — Grand Raid 2026
claims: The organiser welcomes runners and their companions arriving on flights from Paris at Roland Garros airport.
The airport welcome runs from Saturday 3 October to Tuesday 13 October 2026.
Volunteers in T-shirts and with signs meet arrivals after baggage reclaim and guide them to the reception area.
The reception offers coffee, tea, Creole specialities and updates on the routes, weather and trail conditions from the race president or a representative.
The organiser describes Roland Garros as the first aid station of every Grand Raid race.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官方到达机场页正文
